● Remote index: queued jeswnath/copilot-cli for indexing

● skill(sdlc-requirements)

**Assumption:** “Menu button” refers to the control that opens admin-only navigation. Admin functions should also remain inaccessible to non-admins, even if they navigate directly to a URL.

**REQ-ID:** REQ-001  
**Title:** Hide Admin Menu from Non-Admins  
**Description:** The system shall display the admin menu button only to users with an administrator role.  
**Acceptance Criteria:**
  - Given a user without an administrator role
  - When the user views the application
  - Then the admin menu button is not visible
**Priority:** High  
**Dependencies:** None

**REQ-ID:** REQ-002  
**Title:** Restrict Admin Function Access  
**Description:** The system shall deny non-admin users access to admin functions regardless of how they attempt to reach them.  
**Acceptance Criteria:**
  - Given a user without an administrator role
  - When the user attempts to access an admin function directly
  - Then the system denies access
**Priority:** High  
**Dependencies:** None
